edges.reason: msg.sender must equal _owner for multiTransfer; array-controlled batch logic is gated only on caller identity.
increaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner, relying on a mutable owner reference.
decreaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner and overwrites _safeOwner used by the transfer modifier.
addApprove requires msg.sender == _owner and mutates blacklist state.
_mint is public and only checks msg.sender == _owner, a single point of privileged failure.
msg.sender flows into transfer as the sender account for balance debit.
Caller-dependent routing in burnTokenCheck compares sender/recipient against owner-held addresses.
sender parameter drives branch selection in burnTokenCheck, deciding if a transfer is allowed or blacklisted.
recipient parameter participates in the modifier branching conditions.
amount parameter compared against _sellAmount in the modifier controls arithmetic-gated transfer paths.
transfer delegates balance movement to _approveCheck.
_approveCheck execution is guarded by the stateful burnTokenCheck modifier which can mutate blacklist/whitelist state.
Modifier reads and writes _sellAmount to gate transfers.
Modifier reads _whiteAddress to decide bypass of restrictions.
Modifier reads and writes _blackAddress to block senders.
Modifier compares against _owner to determine privileged transfer paths.
Modifier compares and reassigns _safeOwner, the mutable secondary owner.
multiTransfer loops and invokes transfer for each receiver.
multiTransfer writes _whiteAddress entries while iterating.
multiTransfer calls _approve to grant _unirouter unlimited allowance for receivers.
multiTransfer uses _unirouter as spender in unlimited approvals.
Loop counter governs iteration bounds in multiTransfer.
receivers array parameter supplies all addresses processed in multiTransfer.
Low-level call with value inside sendValue transfers control to recipient contract before caller state settles.
Low-level call with value to arbitrary target inside _functionCallWithValue enables reentrant callee execution.
_approveCheck updates _balances for sender and recipient.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint credits _balances[_owner].
transferFrom delegates to _approveCheck before allowance subtraction.
approve delegates to _approve for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom reads and writes _allowances with SafeMath sub.
Constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply for the owner.
Constructor sets _owner from the deployer-supplied owner argument.
_transfer performs unchecked-in-spirit balance arithmetic on _balances.
_approve writes _allowances for owner and spender.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is a plain parameter of _approveCheck and only carries data into that internal transfer routine.
recipient is a plain parameter of _approveCheck consumed by the same function.
amount is a plain parameter of _approveCheck used in its balance arithmetic.
Loop index local variable exists only within multiTransfer.
receivers array parameter is consumed exclusively by the multiTransfer batch loop.
